title: SIGNS TO STRENGTHEN A WEAK FAITH

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then the Lord said to him, "Reach out your hand and take it by the tail." So Moses reached out and took hold of the snake and it turned back into a staff in his hand. "This," said the Lord, "is so that they may believe that the Lord, the God of their fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob—has appeared to you."" - Exodus 4:4-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God tells Moses to pick up a live snake by the tail. Anyone who knows anything about snakes will tell you that is exactly the wrong end. Obedience here required him to do something that felt reckless.

He obeys — and it becomes a staff again in his hand.

Faith often works like this. God asks for a step that makes no sense from where we stand, and the confirmation comes only after we have moved. Moses could not have known it would turn back into a staff until he had already reached out.

God gave these signs, He says, so that they may believe. He knew the people would need help to trust. He was under no obligation to accommodate their weakness, yet He did.

Our God is not annoyed by weak faith. Jesus did not break a bruised reed (Mt 12:20). He met doubting Thomas at the point of his doubt (Jn 20:27). If your faith feels thin today, bring it to Him rather than hiding it.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What has God asked of me that requires moving before I can see the outcome?
2. How has God patiently strengthened my faith in the past?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, my faith is weaker than I would like. Thank You for being patient with me. Help me to reach out and obey. Amen.
